description: This Java class 'IoHelper' provides utility methods for handling binary protocol operations, including CRC32 checksum calculation, packet creation, byte swapping, and response code checking, used within the 'BinaryProtocol' context.

classes.name: IoHelper
classes.description: A utility class for binary protocol operations such as CRC computation and packet formation.

methods.name: getCrc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of the given byte array or a segment of it.

methods.name: makeCrc32Packet
methods.description: Prepares a packet that includes the CRC32 checksum of a command, adding header bytes for size.

methods.name: swap16
methods.description: Swaps byte order of a 16-bit integer.

methods.name: swap32
methods.description: Swaps byte order of a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: putInt
methods.description: Inserts a 4-byte integer into a byte array at specified offset.

methods.name: putShort
methods.description: Inserts a 2-byte short into a byte array at specified offset.

methods.name: checkResponseCode
methods.description: Checks if the response byte array has the expected response code.
